notes: Fixed the real freeze: after the machine slept, the panel kept showing the previous night’s readings and never came back on its own.

The cause was a pipe that stayed OPEN but went SILENT. The app only ever watched for the sensor connection breaking, and sleep does not break it - it just stops the data. So nothing fired, nothing was logged, and the app waited forever on…

The app now judges the sensor feed by whether data is actually arriving, not by whether the socket says it is connected. Twenty seconds of total silence on a feed that normally delivers several readings a second is treated as dead, and it…

The app also had no resume-from-sleep handling at all. It now refreshes every live reader the moment Windows reports a resume, rather than waiting out the silence timer while you look at stale numbers.
The volume/brightness and media readers are restarted on resume too - long-lived background readers can come back from a suspend just as quietly useless as the sensor pipe was.
